mapper.sql: t.trip_id AS id, t.member_id, t.title, t.start_date::text AS start_date, t.end_date::text AS end_date, t.people, t.transports, t.status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM trip t WHERE t.trip_id = #{id} AND t.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip (member_id, title, start_date, end_date, people, transports) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{title}, #{startDate}::date, #{endDate}::date, #{people}, #{transports, typeHandler=com.tripbiseo.config.CsvTypeHandler})
mapper.update: UPDATE trip SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW(), started_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'ongoing' THEN NOW() ELSE started_at END, finished_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'done' THEN NOW() ELSE finished_at END WHERE trip_id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM trip WHERE trip_id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.sql: stop_id AS id, trip_id, day_no AS day, place_id, name, category, address, lat, lng, start_time AS time, stay_min AS stay, fixed, move_mode AS mode, memo, state, to_char(arrived_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS arrived_at, to_char(departed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS departed_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM trip_stop WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY day_no, start_time, stop_id
SELECT FROM trip_stop WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND stop_id = #{stopId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_stop (trip_id, day_no, place_id, name, category, address, lat, lng, start_time, stay_min, fixed, move_mode, memo) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{day}, #{placeId}, #{name}, #{category}, #{address}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{time}, #{stay}, #{fixed}, #{mode}, #{memo})
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_stop SET day_no = #{day}, start_time = #{time}, stay_min = #{stay}, fixed = #{fixed}, move_mode = #{mode}, memo = #{memo}, state = #{state} WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND stop_id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM trip_stop WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND stop_id = #{stopId}
mapper.update: UPDATE trip_stop SET arrived_at = NOW() WHERE stop_id = #{stopId} AND arrived_at IS NULL
UPDATE trip_stop SET departed_at = NOW(), state = 'done' WHERE stop_id = #{stopId} AND departed_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_track (trip_id, lat, lng, accuracy) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{accuracy})
mapper.select: SELECT lat, lng FROM trip_track WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, track_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT k.lat, k.lng, (k.recorded_at::date - t.start_date + 1) AS "day", to_char(k.recorded_at, 'HH24:MI') AS "time" FROM trip_track k JOIN trip t ON t.trip_id = k.trip_id WHERE k.trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY k.recorded_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_chat (trip_id, role, text, created_at) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{role}, #{text}, COALESCE(#{at, jdbcType=VARCHAR}::timestamp, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT role, text, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') AS "at" FROM trip_chat WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY created_at, chat_id
